Remark
[Model values of the Harnack quantity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0343 1. ch25:25.16\group Harnack Quantity

For the Euclidean heat kernel and $\varepsilon =0$, one has $\tau P=-n/2$. For the heat equation on a static manifold with nonnegative Ricci curvature, the Li--Yau estimate is $P\geq -n/(2\tau )$.
